angularDiameterSource: Computed here from the record's radius and distance: 2 x 777,375 km at 36.67 pc = 0.28 mas. No interferometric diameter of this star is used.
distanceSource: Gaia DR3 parallax 27.2686 +/- 0.0151 mas (same row, RUWE 1.07): 36.67 pc, no zero-point correction
radiusSource: Radius 1.1174 +/- 0.0239 solar radii from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar radius of the default parameter set of TOI-2128 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract): 777,375 km at 695,700 km per solar radius. Mass 1.0251 +/- 0.0381 solar masses from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar mass of the default parameter set of TOI-2128 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract); GM is that mass times the JPL solar GM. Temperature 5968 +/- 86 K from MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2128 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract). presentationUp: the display axis is a sky-plane convention; the spin axis's position angle on the sky is not measured.
effectiveTemperatureSource: MacDougall et al. 2023, the stellar temperature of the default parameter set of TOI-2128 b in the NASA Exoplanet Archive (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
surfaceGravitySource: log g from the mass and radius in packages/astronomy/data/bodies/toi-2128.json (sources in its physicalNotes), log10(GM/R^2) in cgs: 4.352, rounded to two decimals
metallicitySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2128 (pscomppars): [Fe/H] -0.07 dex, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
luminositySource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2128 (pscomppars): log10 of the luminosity in solar units 0.15625, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
ageSource: NASA Exoplanet Archive, composite parameters of TOI-2128 (pscomppars): age 4.7 Gyr, from MacDougall et al. 2023 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2023AJ....166...33M/abstract)
projectedRotationSpeedSource: SIMBAD, HD 155060: projected rotation speed 3 km/s, the measurement SIMBAD prefers (2005yCat.3244....0G)

shape.qualification: A sphere at the published radius, colored from the star's Gaia DR3 BP/RP spectrum (photometry/stellar-color.json); no image of the photosphere exists.
